name: Piperidine
aliases: pip, azinane, cyclopentimine, cypentil, FEMA 2908, Hexahydro-Pyridine, hexazane, pentamethyleneamine
summary: Piperidine is an organic compound with the molecular formula (CH2)5NH. This heterocyclic amine consists of a six-membered ring containing five methylene bridges (–CH2–) and one amine bridge (–NH–). It is a colorless liquid with an odor described as objectionable, fishy or like ammonia typical of amines. The name comes from the genus name Piper, which is the Latin word for pepper.
